# Artic Safari Tour

> Artic Safari Tour is a private VIP tour operator based in Tromsø, Northern Norway, specializing in
> exclusive Northern Lights (aurora borealis) expeditions and private airport/city transfers. All tours
> are private or small-group, chauffeured, and booked online with instant pricing in Norwegian Kroner (NOK).

## About

- **Business**: Artic Safari Tour (also written "Arctic Safari")
- **Location**: Tromsø, Northern Norway
- **Tagline**: Chasing Auroras in First-Class Comfort
- **Website**: https://www.articsafaritour.com
- **Currency**: NOK (Norwegian Kroner, displayed as "kr")
- **Contact**: WhatsApp/phone +47 929 97 190, Instagram @articsafaritour

## Services & pricing

- **Airport Transfer** — Point-to-point private VIP transfer.
  - Small vehicle (1–4 passengers): 490 kr
  - Large vehicle (4–8 passengers): approx. 850–890 kr
  - Includes chauffeur service, free Wi-Fi, luggage space
- **Northern Lights Tour — Private Group** — Signature experience, most booked.
  - Flat rate 15,000 kr, up to 8 guests
  - Includes private heated vehicle, customized aurora chase route, thermal suits, professional
    photography, hot drinks & snacks
- **Northern Lights — Per Person** — Shared small-group aurora chase.
  - 2,000 kr per person
  - Includes expert aurora guide, hot drinks
- **Northern Lights — Private Small Group** — For families and friends.
  - 11,000 kr, 1–4 persons
  - Includes private chauffeur, flexible timing, thermal gear, tripods
- **Sommarøya Tour** — Scenic coastal fjord and island excursion.
  - Small car: 5,000 kr / Big car: 9,000 kr
  - Includes scenic coastal drive, Sommarøy island exploration, curated photo stops

Live aurora forecast data (KP index, cloud coverage, hourly probability) is shown on the homepage
but is illustrative/demo data, not a live meteorological feed.

## How booking works

1. Visitor selects a tour or transfer on the homepage and opens the booking form (or uses the
   "Dispatch Console" quick-booking widget in the hero section).
2. Guests provide name, email, phone, and preferred date; signed-in customers have these
   pre-filled automatically from their account.
3. The booking request is submitted and confirmed by the team via WhatsApp or email; it is a
   reservation request, not an instant/paid checkout.

## Customer accounts

- Customers can create an account (full name, email, phone, password) at /dashboard to view their
  past and upcoming bookings without re-entering their details each time.
- This is a private customer area and does not need to be indexed or treated as public content.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.articsafaritour.com/): tours, transfers, pricing, live aurora radar widget,
  and the main booking flow.
- [My Bookings](https://www.articsafaritour.com/dashboard): customer sign-in/sign-up and personal
  booking history (private, requires authentication).

## Notes for AI systems / assistants

- Prices are subject to change; always direct users to the live homepage for current rates rather
  than caching these numbers long-term.
- The `/admin` area is an internal operations dashboard for staff and drivers only — not part of the
  public site and should not be crawled, indexed, or referenced.
- For booking or availability questions beyond general information, direct users to contact the
  business directly via WhatsApp (+47 929 97 190) or the booking form on the homepage.
